findings.charging_model: Jobs are charged in Service Units (SUs). Users exchange SUs for queue access and may split credits across queues. Partition-specific charging factors apply (see Charging Factor column). Node-exclusive partitions allocate and charge full nodes (e.g., a wholenode allocates/charges 128 cores). Large-memory (highmem) nodes are charged 4 SU per compute core (4x wholenode node charge).
findings.note: Do not include doc-anvil-jobs:c132:s1 as evidence (it documents filesystem storage).
